author: PavelMakarchuk
body:
**Verdict: PolicyEngine adjustment.**

Confirmed — PE caps the Form 140PTC credit at property taxes + **100% of rent** instead of the line 13 rent-equivalent property tax (Form 201: rent × landlord's property-tax factor), so the cap never binds for renters and PE returns the full Table 1 amount.

| | Line 11 (table) | Line 13/14 (taxes paid) | Line 15 (credit) |
|---|---|---|---|
| PE 1.768.4 | $457 | $857 (full rent) | **$457** |
| Per form, 15% factor | $457 | $129 | **$129** |

ARS [43-1072(B)](https://www.azleg.gov/ars/43/01072.htm) ("amount of property taxes actually paid... whichever is less") with the landlord factor from 43-1072(C)/Form 201. Since AZ has no statutory fraction, we'll add a parameterized rent-equivalent rate (as we do for MT/WI/MN) — likely matching your 15% default. Tracking: PolicyEngine/policyengine-us#9064.
